lines.zh: 我被人从箱子里抬出来。
lines.en: They lifted me out of the crate.

lines.zh: 之后我就一直站在这儿。
lines.en: And here I have stood ever since.
My soles are fixed to the boards.
Walking is other people's business.
A push rocks me half a sway.
My knees do not bend.

lines.zh: 这间展厅的地我没踩过。
lines.en: I have never trodden this showroom floor.

lines.zh: 我在架子上，换个位置都难。
lines.en: I am on a stand; even shifting is hard.
Dust settles on my hat.

lines.zh: 我一天到晚对着同一面墙。
lines.en: I face the same wall all day.

lines.zh: 要是我能走，这屋子早没人了。
lines.en: If I could walk, this room would be empty.
My shadow has not moved all day.
My teeth stay bared at the corners of my mouth.
The velvet on my hat has flattened.
My bow tie sits crooked.

lines.zh: 身上那道星纹还是亮的。
lines.en: The star pattern on my chest still shines.
The lamps in this room are rarely lit.
I listen to the floorboards.

lines.zh: 有人掀开帘子看了我一眼。
lines.en: Someone parted the curtain and looked at me.
And the curtain closed again.
Dust fills my knuckles.
A fly circles my snout.
I have no hand to wave it off.
I count the panels in the ceiling.

lines.zh: 这里安静得能听见锈响。
lines.en: It is quiet enough to hear rust.
I wait for closing time.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿上有一层薄灰。
lines.en: A thin film of dust coats my teeth.
Someone wiped me down, very lightly.
You have pulled the curtain back.
I have stood behind it a long while.

lines.zh: 你的灯照得我的牙发白。
lines.en: Your lamp bleaches my teeth.
Do not put your hand on my pedestal.
Can you smell the wood?

lines.zh: 这是我身上最浓的味道。
lines.en: It is the strongest smell I have.
Look at my bow tie; it has slipped.
Nobody sets it right.
Your face is a little close.

lines.zh: 我在玻璃后面，你摸不到。
lines.en: I am behind glass; you cannot touch me.

lines.zh: 你把我的影子看清了吗？
lines.en: Have you seen my shadow clearly?
It stands far taller than you.
You are waiting for me to blink.
I will not.
You press your face to the glass.
A patch of fog stays on it.
You count how many teeth I have.
Can you really count them all?
My wood has split.
Dust leaks through the crack.
The pedestal rocked once.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在我的帽子上。
lines.en: That struck my hat.
I lean, and cannot straighten.
Something inside has come loose.
Your handprint is on the glass.

lines.zh: 这具身子本来就不结实。
lines.en: This body was never sturdy.
I can make no sound at all.
Repairs will cost a good deal.
The glass stops your hand.

lines.zh: 我张不开嘴，也说不了话。
lines.en: I can't open my mouth, or speak.
There is no belly in this body.

lines.zh: 你把东西放台座上也没用。
lines.en: Setting it on the pedestal changes nothing.
Smell does not pass through this glass.
I cannot smell it, and cannot eat.
Your arm must be aching by now.
The museum does not feed me.

lines.zh: 你留着，你自己的肚子会响。
lines.en: Keep it; your own stomach will growl.
It would rot here.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是玻璃，不是我。
lines.en: You hit the glass, not me.
The wood behind it did not move either.
My pedestal is steady.
You are pressing on the edge.
Push harder and the attendant comes.
Do not shake it; I would topple.
My hat nearly came off.
You stepped on the nameplate.
My name is written there.
Best not to soil it.
I am only an exhibit.
There is no one inside this shell.
There is a label on the glass.
It says nothing of that.
Your idea is strange.
Saying such things to an exhibit.
I cannot even bow my head.
Just go.
Lingering is not allowed here.
I make no reply.
It fell outside the glass.
I cannot reach out a hand.
My fingers are dead weight.
Pick it up, and do not kick my base.
It rolled to the edge of my shadow.
I have seen it.
People drop things in this room.
The sweeper will deal with it.

lines.zh: 你要是不捡，它就一直躺着。
lines.en: If you leave it, it stays.
Dust has already settled on it.
You knocked on the glass.
I heard it.
I can see you, and you know it.
But this body does not move.
There is a me beyond the glass.
And a nearer one on this side.
Perhaps you should look behind you.

lines.zh: 我一动没动，是你先举手的。
lines.en: I never moved; you raised your hand first.
Did you hear footsteps?
They are not mine.
You laid your hand on the glass.
My pedestal gives a faint creak.
That sound is not from the wood.
You yielded a step back.
Good; just stand there.
You stepped back, then stopped.
You pace in front of the glass.
I cannot follow.
My eyes are painted on.

lines.zh: 你一走到左边，我就看丢。
lines.en: One step left and I lose you.
Come back and look at me.
Have you read the words on the plate?
There is a year on it.
Your light sways.
I cannot even lift an eyelid.

lines.zh: 你在我面前站了一整晚吗？
lines.en: Have you stood before me all night?

lines.zh: 你的影子在玻璃上移动。
lines.en: Your shadow slides across the glass.
Mine has not moved.
You aim the lamp at my face.
My eyes follow the light.
You step to the door and the light recedes.
It is only paint, really.
I watch the hand you reach toward me.
You pulled your hand back.
My teeth are carved.
This bite cannot reach anyone.
The glass is sturdier than you.
Knock on it and your hand will hurt.
My claws only hang at my side.
They do not rise.
You are fighting a piece of wood.
Do not knock the pedestal askew.

lines.zh: 这一下馆员会记你名字。
lines.en: The attendant will take your name for that.
Stand away.

lines.zh: 我的牙离玻璃只有半寸。
lines.en: My teeth are half an inch from the glass.
Reach in and it is just that short.
That was designed.
There are scratches on my base.

lines.zh: 你碰不着我，这就是全部。
lines.en: You cannot reach me; that is all.

lines.zh: 你敲第三下的时候，我没动。
lines.en: I did not move on the third knock.
Somebody lifted my dust sheet.
Light pours into my eyes all at once.
I have stood here for over ten years.
This pedestal is new.
They squared me up a little.
My arm is raised and will not come down.

lines.zh: 木头里有旧油漆的味道。
lines.en: Old paint smells inside the wood.
The gallery is still empty.
The words on the plate have changed.
I watch the door from behind the curtain.

lines.zh: 有人揭开了罩布的一角。
lines.en: Someone lifted a corner of the dust sheet.
He pulled the whole cloth away.
The paint on me is still fresh.
The sign says closed at night.
I stay in this room.

lines.zh: 门锁上的时候会响一声。
lines.en: The lock makes a sound when it turns.
I have heard that sound many times.

lines.zh: 之后就是很长的一段安静。
lines.en: Then comes a long stretch of quiet.

lines.zh: 火从帽子烧下来，油漆在冒泡。
lines.en: Fire spreads down from my hat and the paint bubbles.
The pedestal tips and I break into pieces.

lines.zh: 水漫过玻璃，木头开始发胀。
lines.en: Water rises past the glass and the wood swells.
The blast shatters every pane of glass.

lines.zh: 一块碎片扎进我的肩板。
lines.en: A shard lodges in my shoulder board.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的木头一阵发麻。
lines.en: That light leaves the wood tingling.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是慢慢地朽。
lines.en: I never eat; I simply rot slowly.

lines.zh: 火从我的帽顶烧到脚尖。
lines.en: Fire runs from my hat down to my toes.

lines.zh: 台座下面空了，我连人带座往下掉。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I fall with the pedestal.
